sys_ux_event.description: Fires when the user navigates to a slot — by clicking a nav item, using the keyboard, or pressing Previous/Next. It does NOT fire on initial render (unless "Announce the starting slot" is on), and it does NOT fire when the highlighted item changes because the user scrolled in Show all mode. Bind it to a client state parameter to gate slot content with a Conditional Renderer, so unopened slots never load. Payload: { id, title, icon, group, parent, index, source, visited, visitedIds }.
sys_ux_event.label: Slot selected
